scope: New count-bearing whole-cohort co-splicing network input; complete declared participating sample set for each fit.

input_universe.required_observations: Every participating sample has an actual finite PSI in [0,1] and actual finite nonnegative IJC and SJC with unambiguous event/sample identity.
input_universe.aggregation: logical AND over every participating sample; no count pooling, supported fraction, group mean, supported-replicate subset, or contrast-level OR
input_universe.constant_event_handling: Exclude complete PSI vectors with fewer than two distinct values because correlation is undefined; no additional positive variance floor.
input_universe.missing_or_invalid_input: Cannot pass the count-verified route; record unavailable or block with an explicit reason.
input_universe.repeated_measurement_boundary: The existing rMATS adapter resolves one canonical source per (condition,event type) by largest file size, then lexical path/side order. QC checks all sample observations in the resolved matrix. It neither assembles partial evidence nor takes median/max counts across comparisons, but it does not certify agreement with unselected candidate tables; passing QC is not evidence that all repeated source observations were audited.
input_universe.source_selection_limitation: Conflicting or missing measurements in an unselected comparison table are not validated by this gate. Source choices and candidate counts remain recorded; changing the measurement/source adapter is outside this update.
input_universe.optional_event_cap: max_events=0 uses every eligible event by default; a positive value is a recorded exploratory variance-ranked subset, independent of condition significance.
input_universe.technical_measurement_boundary: Lanes and technical measurements are not promoted to biological replicates.

retired_hard_filters.name: strong_dynamic_range
retired_hard_filters.former_default: At least 10% of samples at PSI 0.2-0.8, or all-sample PSI span >=0.5

diagnostic_boundary: Retired eligibility statistics can be retained as diagnostics, never reactivated as extra hard gates under this policy.

PSI_only_optional_route.scope: Independent optional input with explicit absence of read evidence; not silently promoted to the count-verified route.

method_boundaries.module_parameter_review: User approved standard defaults 20 events and merge cut 0.25; nullable runtime controls preserve custom YAML settings. Discovery kernel unchanged; see network-modules.v1.json.
method_boundaries.biological_design: Passing count support does not establish adequate replication, power, correlation reliability or module-level inference validity.

evidence.supports: Published precedent for junction-count event filtering by at least ten informative reads in each sample.
evidence.does_not_establish: Universal ten-count optimum, direct JCEC validation, validity of every other count-producing assay, or network-level error control.

evidence.supports: Advice against differential-expression-significance selection before unsupervised coexpression networks; applied here by declared analogy to splicing.
evidence.does_not_establish: Direct validation of Katana's PSI count policy, positive effect cutoffs or module parameters.

implementation.test_evidence_scope: Input-QC and execution-contract fixtures; no new native R network fit, biological validation, or recomputation of completed research results.
implementation.policy_recording: Resolved YAML and stage/output provenance record network_input_policy; legacy settings are recorded as diagnostics rather than active gates.
implementation.cache_and_output_boundary: New policy identity enters engine/stage fingerprints; engine production contract v9 uses an independent output location. Legacy output lacking the new policy is not overwritten, including under force.
implementation.test_evidence: 294 application checks and 12 subtests passed; subsequent historical-output guard integration 11 passed after the final protection update. Synthetic fixtures only; no new native R fit.
